morgan: Quick sync on PR 4123 1: update SDK snippets for streaming/resume/retry/pagination across py/ts/go. Need unified porting note + examples. Land by EOD Wed.

jess: I'll do Python snippets + small resume-roundtrip test.

sri: Taking TS; switch to `for await` since client yields AsyncIterable with chunk + resume_token.

dave: I'll write Go loop example showing Next()/ResumeToken(), context timeout, and io.EOF handling.

morgan: replace old `max_retries` references with `retry.max_attempts` and `retry.backoff_ms`; grep and patch TODO in examples.md.

sam: fixed a broken link in examples.md and rebased; preview updated.

jess: Python example will show `retry={"max_attempts":3, "backoff_ms":200}` and `async for` pattern.

sri: TS will show camelCase `retry: { maxAttempts: 3, backoffMs: 200 }` and a tiny jest test asserting chunk.resume_token exists.

dave: Go note will explain at-least-once resume semantics and idempotency caveat; suggest using `idempotency_key` for side-effecting calls.

sam: CI shows docs-lint/linkcheck passed after fixes.

morgan: assigning reviewers @jess @sri @dave 1: please review before EOD Wed. I will add changelog entry when merged.

docs-bot: deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-4123--docs.redwood.ai
